{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
non_numeric_revenue = df[df['revenue_numeric'].isna()]
print(f'Number of rows with non-numeric revenue: {len(non_numeric_revenue)}')

# Display the first few rows of the new column
df[['revenue', 'revenue_numeric']].head()"}
